system.description:
You amplify the bodies of your allies with your draconic chakra, compelling them to fight harder, while also diverting attention to yourself.

All creatures of your choice, excluding yourself within this jutsu’s radius is affected by this jutsu in either a Wyrmling or Prey like fashion. Wyrmling’s are often your allies or non-hostile creatures. While Prey are your foes or hostile creatures.

Dragon Rage State. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, for every creature, hostile or allied, that are affected by this jutsu, you gain +4 Temporary hit points..

Wyrmling’s gain a +1 bonus to their AC and 14 temporary hit points.

Prey must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid being compelled to strike you.

Critical Success: The affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effect.

Success: The affected creature has disadvantage on the next attack they make before the end of their next turn against creatures other than you.

Failure: Affected creatures gain disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you for the duration.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they also gain 2 ranks of your chosen nature releases condition. (Earth Release: Shaken, Wind Release: Bleed, Fire Release: Burned, Water Release: Chilled, Lightning Release: Shocked).

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the temporary hit points granted by +4.
